response.justification: The candidate is a broadly experienced software craftsman with strong web, backend, and systems experience across many languages, but has minimal recent C++ development (a brief stint over a decade ago at National Instruments) and no evidence of Windows-platform C++ work, SQL Server/Oracle expertise, or any fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a short unrelated fintech stint at RIDE Capital using Node/TypeScript.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains and languages
Demonstrated strong communication skills via talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
Some early-career C and C++ component development experience
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development experience (last C++ work was ~2015, and not Windows-focused)
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; only lists generic 'SQL' and MySQL/MongoDB
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain experience despite one fintech-adjacent role using unrelated tech stack

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/relevant C++ on Windows experience
No fixed income / capital markets domain expertise
